brand.name: TanSail Ledger
brand.tagline: A field manual for shipping design-led TanStack sites.
brand.description: A compact, graphic TanSail concept that presents the system as a working manual instead of a conventional software landing page.

audience.primary: Design engineers, independent builders, and product studios
audience.problem: Most starters change colors while preserving the same page hierarchy, density, and product-marketing rhythm.
audience.outcome: Show how TanSail can pair a distinct visual system with a different recipe, section order, and content emphasis.

pages.name: Ledger concept
pages.goal: Demonstrate a structurally different TanSail page through a consulting-studio recipe and Ledger visual system.
